name: Neon/LDR opto tremolo (validation circuit)
description: 6 Hz, ±150 V lamp drive into a neon lamp + CdS LDR ('roach'); the audio passes through 100 kΩ into the LDR shunt to ground. Exercises the neon strike, the light-state attack/release and the LDR conductance law.

sources.title: Fender AB763 vibrato channel topology (neon + LDR shunt); LDR law approximate
